architecture: Treat ELYSION as a trainable native model, not merely a role wrapper.
Keep CEREBRON as orchestration/control plane and SIGMA as meta-manager/teacher integrator.
Use 6 ASTRA functions as complementary workstreams; require real artifacts before counting them as executed.
Use HF-A01..HF-A20 adaptively; do not activate all 20 by default.
contribution.base_selection_rule: Cold benchmark immutable revisions before binding. Do not choose by reputation.
memory: Use cerebron-omega/cerebron-private-memory for durable common validated memory.
Use cerebron-omega/cerebron-sigma-memory for current curated training/model workspace until an ELYSION-specific store is justified.
Never place M6 examples into training or retrieval that can contaminate evaluation.
training: Build ELYSION-GOLD-V1 from reproduced M4 records.
Establish base-model baseline before any weight change.
Prefer reversible adapter training before full-weight training.
Require weights/adapters SHA, dataset SHA, config, seed, before/after M6, transfer and regression.
Promote only reproduced gain; otherwise rollback.
failure_watch: same Qwen lineage mistaken for independent consensus
raw AGORA output promoted directly to GOLD
20-agent fanout producing duplicated lineage rather than information gain
memory growth on GitHub instead of HF private store

requested_from_astra: ASTRA-A: architecture proposal + candidate base + parameter budget
ASTRA-B: training recipe + resource feasibility + rollback
ASTRA-F: synthesis preserving disagreements and evidence limits
